messages.text:
"A 2D platformer featuring side-scrolling combat. The game uses a side-scrolling perspective, with the protagonist fixed on the left side of the screen; gameplay involves horizontal movement, jumping, and melee attacks. Enemies consist of large monsters that appear from the right, characterized by slow attack patterns. Progression follows a sequence of levels with increasing difficulty and item drops. The environment features a backdrop of mountains and trees, with a lighting cycle that transitions through day, sunset, and night. Obstacles—such as gaps, spikes, and logs—are placed along the path, requiring precise timing for jumps.
